title: Rotational constraints on nuclear population memory in a cryptochrome reaction model: computational source companion
description:
Computational source and compiled article/supplement for the motion-dependent Journal of Biological Physics draft (9 October 2026, jbp-motion-2.0.0). The model compares free rotation, protected waits, reversible binding, bound wobble, electric orientation, electronic EFG/HFC response and deformation of an assumed binding well. Neural readout is conditional on prescribed gain and timing.

Only source code, two compiled PDFs and minimal project metadata are included. Simulation results, frozen operators, trajectories, checkpoints, raw trial records and the separate numerical Online Resource 2 archive are excluded. Full numerical reproduction requires external inputs described in README. No native neural mechanism or biological effect size is established.
notes: Source code is released under the MIT License. The manuscript and supplement PDFs (paper/manuscript.pdf, paper/supplement.pdf) are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party source data are not redistributed.
